title: S3 - a rubric that measures three things at once
doc_ref: docs.typesafe.ai/primitives/score - 'Keep each Score question to one dimension'
note: The same five reports under two rubrics. The clean rubric describes detail alone. The polluted one bundles detail with politeness and urgency, which the docs say makes a state that is high on one and low on another impossible to place. Three of the five states were written to pull the dimensions apart: a rude but thorough report, a polite but empty one, and a calm report of an emergency.

report_quality.instructions: How much detail does this report give?
criteria: States only that something is wrong, with no detail
Describes what the user did and what happened instead
Includes exact steps, environment, and evidence such as logs
Somewhat detailed, reasonably polite, and moderately urgent
